title: ⚡ Moamaxs Tools Mod
body:
Moamaxs Redstone is a powerful client-side mod for Minecraft, designed especially for builders, redstone engineers, and creative players. It combines useful tools, practical features, and a clean gameplay experience in one mod.

With the integrated WorldEdit Wand, you can quickly and easily set two positions and efficiently build large projects. This is complemented by smart redstone tools: the Redstone Wand shows important information about circuits, while the Signal Analyzer scans a 3×3×3 area and displays signals clearly. With the Wire Cutter, you can precisely remove redstone components.

Another highlight is the Fullbright mode, which can be activated with a key press and gives you perfect visibility in any environment – without the need for torches.

The mod is lightweight, easy to use, and ideal for anyone who wants to build and experiment faster, smarter, and more efficiently in Minecraft. 🚀
